description: This source file contains shell functions related to the Zyxel device upgrade process, including retrieving root filesystem device, flashing new firmware, and performing the upgrade logic based on device specifics.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the flashing of kernel and root filesystem images onto the device, handling loopback device setup and formatting.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process, selecting kernel and root filesystem partitions based on device state and invoking flash routines.
